description: Six inputs: exact existing owner-population head, conditional selected-family actual formation, MF2 selected reflexivity and three unchanged causal policies derive SOME bare actually existing necessary individual by scoped reductio. Actual reflexivity supplies necessity-to-actuality directly; it is not used to fabricate CF2 actual-part existence. No necessary selected cause, concreteness, L1/L2/A1/Euclidean/S5/PSR/source binding or independent truth claim. Same named input counts as CF2 counterparts; different commitments, not a global weakening. The actual family member/sum is obtained only inside the discharged assumption; Model.explains remains unused data.
